page.overview:
Who is Illeisien?

Illeisien is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

Illeisien is the leader of five Aes Sedai who accidentally encountered Tenobia Kazadi on her way out of Saldaea. She is described as being intent on secrecy - more so then Tenobia herself.

This group is uncommited to any faction - loyalist or rebel - so they are not Red nor Blue Ajah; they accompany Tenobia south. Category:Unaligned sisters Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
